repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Tauri 和 Rust 构建的跨平台 Clash Meta 图形化客户端，支持多系统运行。内置 mihomo 内核，提供可视化节点与规则编辑、配置文件增强、TUN 模式及 WebDAV 同步，为用户提供高效、个性化的代理体验。
repos.summary_en: A modern, cross-platform GUI client for Clash Meta, built on Tauri 2 and Rust. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, offering visual configuration, powerful rule editing, TUN mode, and WebDAV sync for a highly tailored proxy experience.

repos.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others
repos.summary_zh: v2rayN是一款跨平台图形界面客户端，支持Windows、Linux和macOS。集成Xray、sing-box等多种代理核心，提供多架构支持与GPG签名校验，保障安全与完整性，是桌面端高效的网络代理工具。
repos.summary_en: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI client supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It integrates Xray, sing-box, and other proxy cores, offering multi-architecture support and GPG-signed releases for secure, reliable, and user-friendly desktop network proxy management.

repos.description: Remove large amounts of unwanted applications quickly.
repos.summary_zh: 批量强力系统卸载工具，专为快速清理大量冗余应用而生。支持批量静默卸载、深度残留清理及孤儿软件检测，兼容Windows商店、Steam及多种安装格式，极大简化IT系统维护与软件清理流程。
repos.summary_en: Bulk Crap Uninstaller (BCUninstaller) is a powerful, free Windows desktop utility designed for rapid batch uninstallation of unwanted applications. It excels at cleaning system leftovers, detecting orphaned software, and automating mass removals with minimal user input, offering deep integration for Windows Store, Steam, and various installer formats.

repos.description: 🖱️ 纯粹的Windows右键菜单管理程序
repos.summary_zh: ContextMenuManager 是一款纯粹的 Windows 右键菜单管理程序，核心价值在于允许用户自由启用、禁用或自定义右键菜单项，适用于文件、文件夹等多种场景。技术亮点包括直接操作注册表、支持多版本 Windows 和 .NET Framework，提供直观界面，帮助高级用户高效优化系统菜单。
repos.summary_en: ContextMenuManager is a dedicated Windows context menu management tool that empowers users to enable, disable, or customize right-click menu items across various scenarios like files and folders. Key features include direct registry manipulation, compatibility with multiple Windows versions and .NET Framework, and a user-friendly interface for advanced users to efficiently optimize system menus.

repos.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.
repos.summary_zh: 该面板提供VLESS、Trojan和Warp配置的Worker订阅，内置私有DoH服务器及链式代理，支持全DNS、清洁IP、Fragment、Warp Pro和路由设置，适用于Amnezia、Wireguard、Sing-box、Clash/Mihomo和Xray核心的跨平台客户端，确保网络自由与安全。
repos.summary_en: BPB Worker Panel is a GUI panel that provides subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan, and Warp configurations, along with a private DoH server and chain proxies. It offers comprehensive settings for DNS, clean IP, Fragment, Warp Pro, and routing, ensuring connectivity even when domains or services are blocked. Designed for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo, and Xray cores, it supports bypassing censorship and sanctions, providing a secure and private proxy solution for users worldwide. With intuitive navigation and full customizability, it is an ideal tool for managing network privacy.

repos.description: 一个支持windows/linux/mac的文本编辑器，目标是做中国人自己的编辑器，来自中国。
repos.summary_zh: Notepad-- 是一款轻量级跨平台文本编辑器，致力于国产软件替代，支持Windows、Linux和Mac系统。重点优化国产信创Uos系统，具有跨平台兼容性和高效编辑能力，适用于日常办公和开发场景，提供稳定可靠的文本编辑体验。
repos.summary_en: Notepad-- is a lightweight cross-platform text editor focused on providing a domestic alternative for Chinese users. It supports Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems, with special optimization for domestic innovation systems like UOS. The key features include cross-platform compatibility, lightweight design, and efficient text editing capabilities, making it suitable for various office and development tasks.

repos.description: 一款免费开源的 Windows 系统重装工具
repos.summary_zh: LetRecovery 是一款免费开源的 Windows 系统重装工具，基于 Rust 语言开发，利用原生 Win32 API 实现高效系统部署。支持多格式镜像（WIM/ESD/SWM/GHO/ISO），具备桌面与 WinPE 双端操作能力，可自动处理 BitLocker 加密盘、生成无人值守应答文件，并提供系统备份、在线下载、驱动维护等高级功能。适用于 Windows 7-11 及旧版系统，兼顾 Legacy 与 UEFI 引导模式，是系统维护与重装的实用工具，特别适合需要快速重装和恢复系统的用户。
repos.summary_en: LetRecovery is a free and open-source Windows system reinstallation tool developed in Rust, leveraging native Win32 API for efficient system deployment. It supports multiple image formats (WIM/ESD/SWM/GHO/ISO) and offers both desktop and WinPE operation modes. The tool can automatically handle BitLocker-encrypted drives, generate unattend.xml files, and provides advanced features like system backup, online downloads, and driver maintenance. Compatible with Windows 7-11 and older systems, it works with both Legacy and UEFI boot modes, making it a practical tool for system maintenance and reinstallation, especially for users who need quick system recovery.

repos.description: Independent, unofficial Telegram client for Android, Windows, and macOS. Sign in with your existing Telegram account — built with Flutter on TDLib.
repos.summary_zh: Navo是一款基于Flutter和TDLib构建的跨平台非官方Telegram客户端，支持Android、iOS、Windows和macOS多端登录。其核心价值在于通过跨平台技术提供独立、高效且安全的即时通讯服务，实现无缝的跨设备聊天体验。
repos.summary_en: Navo is a highly independent, unofficial Telegram client engineered to deliver a seamless, native messaging experience across Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS. Built using the Flutter framework integrated with the powerful TDLib library, it allows users to log in with their existing Telegram accounts safely. Its core strength lies in cross-platform consistency, ensuring efficient message synchronization and a robust, independent chat interface on every major desktop and mobile operating system.

repos.description: C-SSH 0.9.0 · Windows / Apple Silicon Mac / Android · SSH, RDP, AI & self-hosted cloud. Manual download required. 三端正式版，本次须手动下载安装。
repos.summary_zh: C-SSH是一款跨平台服务器运维客户端，集成SSH、RDP、AI对话及自托管云功能。支持Windows、Mac、Android及Linux多端手动下载，本地Agent无需云端登录，数据保留本地，提升运维效率与安全性。
repos.summary_en: C-SSH is a powerful cross-platform server operations client integrating SSH, RDP, AI, and self-hosted cloud capabilities. It supports manual downloads across Windows, macOS, Android, and Linux, featuring local Agent support without requiring cloud login, keeping AI conversations and credentials local for secure, efficient, and flexible server management.

repos.description: 海因影视，用于lunatv（moontv）的Android TV客户端，以及手机、Windows等多平台客户端，本地缓存比网页版更流畅的访问速度
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台 LunaTV 影视客户端，支持 TV、手机、Windows 及 Linux 多端同步。通过本地缓存与多播放器后端，实现超越网页版的流畅播放，完美适配大屏焦点导航与低版本安卓设备。
repos.summary_en: HeinPlay is a high-performance, cross-platform LunaTV client built with Flutter, supporting Android TV, mobile, Windows, Linux, and HarmonyOS. By leveraging local caching and flexible player backends like fvp and ExoPlayer, it provides smoother streaming than the official web version, optimized for TV focus navigation and legacy Android devices.

repos.description: 用一根 USB 数据线把安卓手机/平板变成 Windows 的第二块显示器——是真扩展桌面而不是投屏镜像。端到端延迟实测 5–11 ms，支持触摸反控，拔线即摘屏。全部源代码由 AI 编写。
repos.summary_zh: DroidExtend 是一款通过 USB 数据线将安卓手机/平板转化为 Windows 真扩展显示器的工具，支持窗口拖拽与触摸反控，端到端延迟仅 5–11ms。它基于 adb 隧道传输、NVENC 硬件编码与虚拟显示驱动，无需 Wi-Fi，即插即用，为多屏办公提供低延迟、高可靠的显示扩展方案。
repos.summary_en: DroidExtend is a tool that converts an Android phone or tablet into a genuine secondary display for Windows over a USB cable, not a screen mirror. It supports dragging windows to the phone and touch back control, achieving end-to-end latency as low as 5–11 ms. By using adb reverse tunneling, NVENC hardware encoding, and a virtual display driver, it requires no Wi-Fi or third-party apps, providing a low-latency, reliable extended desktop experience for multi-monitor productivity.
